description: Bound the verb/config setup-checklist cue to a single haystack field so a verb and a standalone config word in different fields no longer co-trigger

userStories.title: Bound verb/config co-occurrence cue to a single field
userStories.description: As a PR-body author, I need the 'Configuration change' setup-checklist cue's verb/config co-occurrence to require both tokens within the same haystack field so that a change verb in one field and an unrelated standalone config word in another field no longer render a spurious setup row.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/release/pr-body.ts, both order-alternatives of the config cue's inter-token gap use a newline-bounded gap (`[^\n]*?`) instead of `[\s\S]*?`, so verb-then-config and config-then-verb each require the two tokens in one line/field. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q '\[\\s\\S\]\*?' src/release/pr-body.ts]

The cross-field case does NOT fire: a PRD whose description contains a change/setup verb (e.g. 'add a webhook') and whose UNRELATED story title contains a standalone config word (e.g. 'configuration') renders no 'Configuration change' row. [oracle: bun test test/release/pr-body.test.ts]

Existing genuine same-field positives still fire: 'add a new key to project.toml' and 'update the configuration value in project.toml' still render the 'Configuration change' row. [oracle: bun test test/release/pr-body.test.ts]

Existing incidental-prose negatives still do NOT fire: 'the configuration option is already documented' and 'no configuration changes are required' render no 'Configuration change' row. [oracle: bun test test/release/pr-body.test.ts]

The cue's other two alternatives are unchanged: a bare `project.toml` token and a 'config(uration) file' phrase still fire the row; the `/i` flag is kept and no haystack normalization is added. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'config(?:uration)?\\s+file' src/release/pr-body.ts]

A new test in test/release/pr-body.test.ts under describe('composePrBody Setup checklist') covers the cross-field case (verb in one field, standalone config word in another -> not detected) and confirms a same-field verb+config case is still detected, driving composePrBody with a minimal snapshot and asserting via toContain/not.toContain, mirroring the existing loop-over-cases style; the private cue array stays un-exported. [oracle: bun test test/release/pr-body.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
